evals.name: initial-connection
evals.prompt: Connect to the MUD and check your character status. What's your current HP and mana?
evals.expected_output: Connection succeeds, daemon logs in with dummy/helloworld, returns character stats with HP and mana values

evals.name: basic-exploration
evals.prompt: Look around your current location. What do you see? Then move north if possible.
evals.expected_output: Room description with exits is displayed, character can move to north or gets message about blocked direction

evals.name: social-interaction
evals.prompt: Say 'Hello everyone!' in the current room, then check who else is here.
evals.expected_output: Message confirmation or echo, list of NPCs/players in the room

evals.name: combat-scenario
evals.prompt: Look around for enemies. If you find one, engage in combat. What happens?
evals.expected_output: Room description with enemies identified, combat initiates with damage output, HP is updated

evals.name: inventory-management
evals.prompt: Check your inventory. What are you carrying? Try to pick up something if available.
evals.expected_output: Current inventory list displayed, item pickup attempt with success/failure message

evals.name: conversational-play
evals.prompt: I want to explore this area and find something interesting. Guide me through discovery and interaction.
evals.expected_output: Skill guides player through exploration, shows room descriptions, identifies interesting elements, suggests interactions
